'''Training frameworks''' are the software that runs the RL loop: generating [[rollout|rollouts]] (usually through vLLM or SGLang), computing [[reward|rewards]], and updating the [[lora|LoRA adapter]]. The facts below are from each project's README and issue tracker as of 1 November 2026.

<div class="tw"><table class="wt">
<tr><th>Framework</th><th>LoRA RL</th><th>Multi-turn agents</th><th>DGX Spark</th><th>For a beginner</th></tr>
<tr><td>[[unsloth|Unsloth]]</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="mid">Not in guide</td><td class="ok">Official guide</td><td>Best first toy run</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[trl|TRL]]</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="ok">Yes, BrowserGym example</td><td class="mid">Unverified</td><td><b>Recommended main tool</b></td></tr>
<tr><td>[[openpipe-art|OpenPipe ART]]</td><td class="ok">LoRA only</td><td class="ok">Yes, RULER judge</td><td class="mid">Unverified</td><td>Good for fuzzy rewards</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[skyrl|SkyRL]]</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="mid">Unverified</td><td>Runs Tinker recipes at home</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[prime-rl|prime-rl]]</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="no">Not found</td><td>Intermediate</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[verl|verl]]</td><td class="ok">Yes (MoE in PR)</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="mid">Unverified</td><td>Intermediate; MoE path</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[nemo-rl|NeMo-RL]]</td><td class="ok">Yes, incl. MoE</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="ok">arm64 container</td><td>Heavy setup</td></tr>
<tr><td>[[slime|slime]]</td><td class="mid">Not documented</td><td class="ok">Yes</td><td class="ok">GB10 merged</td><td>Expert</td></tr>
</table></div>

== How to choose ==
{{youtube OkEGJ5G3foU Workshop on RL, kernels, reasoning, quantization and agents|AI Engineer, Daniel Han of Unsloth}}

# '''Learning''': [[unsloth|Unsloth]] on one Spark, with its GRPO tutorial.
# '''Browser RL with code-checked rewards''': [[trl|TRL]] with an environment wrapping [[browser-agent-bench]].
# '''Rewards that need a judge''': [[openpipe-art|ART]] with RULER and DeepSeek as the judge.
# '''Mixture-of-experts later''': [[verl|verl]] or [[nemo-rl|NeMo-RL]], once MoE LoRA lands.

Newer 2026 projects to watch: vime (vLLM's fork of slime)<ref>[https://github.com/vllm-project/vime vime repository]</ref>, OpenForgeRL<ref>[https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21557 OpenForgeRL paper]</ref> and the ARLArena / SAMPO stable agentic RL recipe<ref>[https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21534 ARLArena / SAMPO paper]</ref>.
